publication_only_changes: Complete trailing standard Apache2 license text in NOTICE; original filtered NOTICE excerpt and its hash remain in measured bundle. LinkedIn BSD2 and Huawei MIT retained; JIT, provider, adapter, CLI, tests and scientific measurements unchanged.
limitations: Instrumented device operation spans, not ordinary application or allocator latency.
Source-controlled power-of-two BLOCK=min(2048,nextpow2V), not public MAX_FUSED_SIZE3840 dispatch or vendor autotuner best.
Charged common Triton reset helpers replace upstream Torch copy_/zero_ backend; no upstream memory-copy throughput claim.
AFTER always computes discarded internal gradient for loss-only cases; both return gradient None there.
All-ignored source mean loss0 convention differs from PyTorch NaN.
Upstream scales gradient only; loss unchanged. Source mean/smoothing/ignore formula and online reduction order retained.
Both arms already use online statistics; this is gradient eagerness, not initial E10 log-probability materialization elimination.
All ten samples retained including cold/variable first samples; no extra warmup, outlier removal, unprofiled timing, or replay.
No physical HBM-byte/instruction-count/occupancy/roofline proof inferred from source or task durations.
Compiler artifacts retain full ELF/text/relocations and IR; no independently decoded instruction-count claim.
Native host clock trails local job-handle clock; C timers govern watchdogs.
Paired FP32 bits are secondary observations, fixed independent FP64 loss/dx tolerances govern.
